description: This file defines the Proxy class in the GuzzleHttp library, providing static methods to create wrapped handlers for synchronous and streaming HTTP requests.

classes.name: Proxy
classes.description: Provides static methods to create handler proxies for synchronous and streaming HTTP requests.

methods.name: wrapSync
methods.description: Creates a handler that directs synchronous requests to a specified handler, and all others to a default handler.

methods.name: wrapStreaming
methods.description: Creates a handler that directs streaming requests to a streaming handler, and all others to a default handler.
